segments.t: Welcome to Episode 2 of Behind the Scenes. After Xingtian's surprise victory on Twelve Singers, chief producer Chun Yuqiao meets rival producer Xie Ling in a quiet evening lounge over honey pomelo tea. Listen to their conversation first.
约我来干什么呀？
不就昨天晚上赢了吗？
不用，我没那习惯。
没给你点咖啡，知道你昨晚睡得不好。
给你点了一杯蜂蜜柚子茶。
昨晚的十二歌王看了吧？
特别好，但是我很好奇。
你把柳凡也安排住这酒店了吧？
你别装了，赶紧告诉我。
我安排她母亲住在这儿。
她参加我们的节目，也是一件好事。
这么晚打扰了，我先走了。
Let's break down what they say. Xie Ling starts with a suspicious question.
约我来干什么呀？
'Why did you ask me out here?' Opening with "yue" means setting up a time to meet someone. At the end, "gan shenme ya" asks 'to do what?' with a soft final "ya".
不就昨天晚上赢了吗？
'Did you not just win last night?' Putting "bu jiu" before "ying le ma", 'won?', shrugs off the victory as 'all that happened was you won'.
不用，我没那习惯。
'No need, I do not have that habit.' Yuqiao brushes off the accusation with "bu yong", 'no need', and "xiguan", the everyday word for 'habit'.
没给你点咖啡，知道你昨晚睡得不好。
'I did not order coffee for you, since I know you slept poorly last night.' Here "dian" means ordering food or drinks, while "shui de bu hao" links "shui", 'sleep', to 'not well' through "de".
给你点了一杯蜂蜜柚子茶。
'I ordered a cup of honey pomelo tea for you.' Count drinks with "yi bei", 'one cup'. "Fengmi youzi cha" stacks 'honey', 'pomelo', and 'tea' in exact order.
昨晚的十二歌王看了吧？
'You watched Twelve Singers last night, right?' Adding "ba" after "kan le", 'watched', turns a statement into a confident 'you watched it, right?'.
特别好，但是我很好奇。
'Very good, though I am really curious.' "Tebie" boosts "hao" to 'especially good', and "haoqi" combines 'fond of' with 'strange' to mean 'curious'.
你把柳凡也安排住这酒店了吧？
'Did you arrange for Liu Fan to stay at this hotel too?' Using "ba" pulls Liu Fan ahead of "anpai", 'arrange', before naming "jiudian", 'hotel'.
你别装了，赶紧告诉我。
'Stop pretending and hurry up and tell me.' "Bie zhuang le" tells someone to drop the act, and "ganjin" urges them to do something right away.
我安排她母亲住在这儿。
'I arranged for her mother to stay here.' "Muqin" is a respectful word for 'mother', more formal than everyday "mama", paired with "zhu zai zher", 'stay here'.
她参加我们的节目，也是一件好事。
'Joining our show is also a good thing for her.' Notice "yi jian haoshi": Mandarin counts matters and events with "jian", right before "haoshi", 'good thing'.
这么晚打扰了，我先走了。

'Sorry to bother you so late; I will head off first.' Saying "darao le", 'I disturbed you', is a polite way to excuse a late meeting before "wo xian zou le", 'I am leaving first'. Now let's hear the whole conversation once more.
约我来干什么呀？
不就昨天晚上赢了吗？
不用，我没那习惯。
没给你点咖啡，知道你昨晚睡得不好。
给你点了一杯蜂蜜柚子茶。
昨晚的十二歌王看了吧？
特别好，但是我很好奇。
你把柳凡也安排住这酒店了吧？
你别装了，赶紧告诉我。
我安排她母亲住在这儿。
她参加我们的节目，也是一件好事。
这么晚打扰了，我先走了。

Yuqiao reveals how he quietly won singer Liu Fan's trust, though he still has one sharp warning left for Xie Ling. You learned how to order a drink with "dian", say 'stop pretending' with "bie zhuang le", and take your leave with "wo xian zou le". See you next time!
回头见！
